Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:179509
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 40640 of 2023
Applicant :- Bhagwanti Devi

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Awashesh Kumar,Kalp Dev Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Kalp Dev Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Pradeep Kumar, learned AGA for the State.
3. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 138 of 2023, under Sections 304-B, 498A IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Shadiabad, District Ghazipur during pendency of the trial.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and her family members including her son i.e. husband of the deceased and according to the FIR marriage of the deceased was performed with the son of the applicant in May, 2018 and after marriage applicant and her family members tortured the deceased for Rs. 1 lakh and motorcycle and on 13.06.2023 informant received an information that applicant and her family members hanged the deceased due to want of dowry.

Bhagwanti Devi vs State Of U.P. on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142797867/

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of torture and demand of dowry she has been made accused in the present matter.

He further submits that actually marriage of the deceased and son of the applicant was love marriage and after marriage husband i.e. son of the applicant started doing job in Pune (Maharashtra) and deceased always pressurized him to live with him in Pune (Maharashtra) and when her husband could not fulfill her desire then she committed the suicide.
6. He further submits that post mortem report of the deceased also suggests that deceased died due to hanging.
He further submits that applicant is lady and in the present matter she is in jail since 12.07.2023.

7. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her and deceased died due to hanging.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. Considering the fact that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and no specific allegation has been made against her and post mortem report of the deceased suggests that she died due to hanging and in paragraph-19 applicant has taken a specific plea that husband of the deceased did job in Pune (Maharashtra) and deceased wanted to live with him, therefore, she committed suicide,
in my view, applicant, who is mother-in-law, is entitled to be released on bail.
10. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

11. Let the applicant - Bhagwanti Devi be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
12. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

13.
